STATEMENT OF WORK (SYNTHETIC — CORE-200 TEST FIXTURE — DISTRACTOR)
Solicitation No.: SYN-H-0008
Title: Medical Supply Warehouse Inventory and Distribution Support

1. SCOPE
The Contractor shall provide warehouse inventory management and
distribution support for medical supply items at the notional
installation's medical logistics warehouse.

2. REQUIREMENTS
2.1 Maintain cycle-count accuracy of medical supply inventory.
2.2 Process outbound distribution requests to clinic sites.
2.3 Track expiration dates and flag items for rotation.

3. PLACE OF PERFORMANCE
Medical logistics warehouse, notional installation.
